message:
All tests pass now (2/2).

The failure was a wrong expectation in the test, not a bug in the code. The test asserted `withVat(250)` equals 301, but 20% VAT on 250p is 50p, so the gross amount is 300p. `src/vat.js` already returned 300. I changed the expected value in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300 and left the implementation alone, since changing it to produce 301 would have made the VAT calculation wrong.

I haven't committed the change. The `src/` directory is untouched.
